title: How to Restore Old Photos with Codex MCP and Medux
description: This tutorial shows a clean agent workflow: Codex finds the local old photo, calls the Medux photo-repair tool through MCP, uploads the image, tracks the task, and saves the restored PNG back into the workspace.
